Selected composition C: elevated diagonal camera looking down, witch head/hat and upper torso in upper left, one reaching black-gloved hand points diagonally toward lower right; a few dark paper cards descend into a large curved volcanic energy funnel in lower right with a pale small hot center, a broad orange sweep joins right upper edge to the funnel. DRAFT V1 emphasis: character face and gloved gesture clearly readable, face occupies about 12 percent of frame width, hat/torso/hand form one connected dark shape. Orange funnel occupies lower-right third, rest of background broad quiet desaturated violet-gray. Hold energy palette in gray-red/orange with a small ivory hot core; strongly grouped illumination, sparse warm reflected marks on glove. Same muted grounded painting feel as approved cards.
